description: This file defines the Session class within the OpenCart framework, responsible for managing user sessions including starting, closing, destroying, and garbage collection of session data through various adaptors.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Manages user sessions by interfacing with session adaptors for storage and retrieval, including session lifecycle methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the session object, loads the specified adaptor, and registers shutdown functions for closing and garbage collection.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a new session or resumes an existing one by session ID, performing validation and loading session data.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Saves session data to persistent storage.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes current session data and removes session from storage.
